#include <iostream>
#include <algorithm>

using namespace std;

long long answer(long long n, long long m) {
    if (n > m) {
        long long t = n;
        n = m;
        m = t;
    }
    if (n == 1) {
        return m / 6 * 6 + max(m % 6 - 3, 0LL) * 2;
    }
    if (n == 2) {
        if (m == 2) return 0;
        if (m == 3) return 4;
        if (m == 7) return 12;
        return n * m;
    }
    return n * m / 2 * 2;
}

int main() {
    long long n, m;
    cin >> n >> m;
    cout << answer(n, m) << endl;
    return 0;
}
